rules.name: The Chip Rule
rules.body: Colour lives in whole fields (a chip, a column header, an order band), never as a thin coloured edge on a white box.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: Every colour carries a written label next to it. Colour never carries meaning alone.

rules.name: The Ink-on-Light Rule
rules.body: Trigo and Harina take Tinta text; every other chip takes white.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a figure or a heading: no colour names, codes or eyebrow labels.

rules.name: The System-Font Rule
rules.body: Never embed SF Pro files; ask the system for it and keep Inter as the bundled fallback.
